cohort: A 30-year-old woman presented with a cyclically enlarging bluish mass adjacent to her previous cesarean section scar.
finding: Intramuscular abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) can manifest years after a cesarean section, mimicking other conditions, and requires detailed clinical assessment, appropriate imaging, and comprehensive surgical planning for effective management.
mod_finding: A history of prior abdominal surgeries, particularly cesarean sections, is recognized as a contributing factor to the development of abdominal wall endometriosis.
